questions.text: What is the chemical formula for water?
What force pulls objects toward the ground?
What instrument is used to measure temperature?
What instrument makes tiny things like cells look bigger?
questions.hostNotes: Not a magnifying glass, which is not strong enough to see cells.

questions.text: Which part of a plant absorbs water from the soil?
At what temperature in Celsius does water boil at sea level?
Which scientist developed the theory of relativity?
Which English scientist wrote the three laws of motion?
What process do plants use to make food from sunlight?
Which Albay volcano is famous for its near-perfect cone shape?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Mayon Volcano, Mount Mayon.

questions.text: What is the name of the Philippine government's weather bureau?
questions.hostNotes: Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration.

questions.text: Which Batangas volcano sits in the middle of a lake?
The Richter scale measures the strength of what natural event?
What is the hardest natural substance on Earth?
What is the center of an atom called?
What gas gives soft drinks their fizz?
What is the chemical name of table salt?
Which subatomic particle has a negative charge?
What gas makes up most of Earth's atmosphere?
questions.hostNotes: Not oxygen. Nitrogen is about 78% of the air, oxygen about 21%.

questions.text: What is the pH of pure water?
What is the chemical symbol for gold?
questions.hostNotes: From the Latin "aurum". Not Ag, which is silver.

questions.text: Which metal is liquid at a standard room temperature of 25 °C?
What part of a cell is known as its "powerhouse"?
Which scientist proposed the theory of evolution by natural selection?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Darwin, Alfred Russel Wallace (who proposed it with Darwin in 1858).

questions.text: Who was the first woman to win a Nobel Prize?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Curie. She won in Physics (1903) and again in Chemistry (1911).

questions.text: What is the scientific study of weather and the atmosphere called?
questions.hostNotes: Despite the name, it is not the study of meteors.

questions.text: The Philippines lies on what horseshoe-shaped belt of volcanoes and earthquakes around the Pacific?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Pacific Ring of Fire.

questions.text: Which Philippine government agency monitors volcanoes and earthquakes?
questions.hostNotes: Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology. Not PAGASA, which handles weather.

questions.text: Which Luzon volcano had one of the 20th century's largest eruptions in 1991?
What do you call a destructive flow of volcanic debris mixed with water?
Who discovered penicillin in 1928?
What is the most abundant element in the universe?
questions.hostNotes: Not oxygen or helium. Helium is second.

questions.text: What do you call a substance that speeds up a chemical reaction without being used up?
What does DNA stand for?
questions.hostNotes: Must be the full term. Accept minor mispronunciations.

questions.text: What is it called when a solid turns directly into a gas, like dry ice?
questions.hostNotes: Not evaporation, which starts from a liquid.

questions.text: What is the bending of light as it passes from air into water called?
questions.hostNotes: Not reflection, which is light bouncing off a surface.

questions.text: Which Russian chemist created the first widely used periodic table, in 1869?
What is the SI base unit of temperature?
questions.hostNotes: Not Celsius, which is a derived unit.

questions.text: What type of rock forms when magma or lava cools and hardens?
What property of a sound wave determines its pitch?
What scale ranks minerals from talc at 1 to the hardest at 10?
What is the SI unit of electric current?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: amp. Not volt or watt.

questions.text: Which physicist imagined a cat in a box that is both alive and dead?
The International Rice Research Institute (IRRI) is based in which Laguna town?
Which Filipino National Scientist and pediatrician devised a bamboo incubator for rural areas?
questions.hostNotes: She founded the first pediatric hospital in the Philippines.
